required_surface: Home, company/about, team, contact, trust, SEO and policy links
acceptance_test: Anonymous GET/HEAD; verify redirects, mobile render, links, metadata, consent, contact submission and email receipt

required_surface: Business service discovery, business review intake, consultation/demo and owner handoff
acceptance_test: Submit disposable business enquiry; confirm consent, persisted record, dedupe/idempotency, correct owner notification and audit trail
dependencies: Database; intake gateway; SMTP; external inquiry handoff

required_surface: Personal cyber-safety path, service discovery, eligibility and support
acceptance_test: Complete individual journey with test identity; confirm copy, consent, data handling and owner handoff

required_surface: Service descriptions, scope, deliverables and limitations
acceptance_test: Check every service claim against staffed capability, telemetry, contract, response coverage and actual operating procedure

required_surface: Intel landing, news/report details, source provenance, timestamps and freshness
acceptance_test: Verify ingestion source, publication timestamps, dedupe, stale-feed behavior, attribution and manual correction
dependencies: News feed, source health, scheduler, database

required_surface: Login, logout, recovery, session revocation and protected access
acceptance_test: Test anonymous, valid, expired, revoked and cross-tenant sessions; confirm password reset invalidates previous sessions

required_surface: Eligibility, KYC/KYB forms, upload, manual review, status and decisions
acceptance_test: Confirm routes match actual service need, privacy/retention approved, uploads safely stored, manual-review path works and disabled gates stay disabled
dependencies: Database; evidence vault; storage; compliance owner

required_surface: Dashboard, profile, settings, documents, requests, messages, meetings, notifications and activity
acceptance_test: Role matrix test across two organizations; no cross-tenant reads/writes; audit and document access tested

required_surface: Admin login, user/role management, intake, KYC, approvals, audit, content and operational controls
acceptance_test: Test anonymous, client, org-admin, operator, admin and superadmin; enforce server-side permissions and log sensitive actions
dependencies: Auth; RBAC; audit store; workspace scope

required_surface: Audit trails, evidence retention, legal hold, deletion requests and policy controls
acceptance_test: Exercise retention/deletion lifecycle and legal hold in test data; verify least privilege, immutable audit and fail-closed defaults
dependencies: Database; storage; scheduled scanner; legal approval

required_surface: Public disclosure, access request, member profile, directory, events, messages and moderation
acceptance_test: Verify public redirect, noindex and preview disclosure; ensure no mock members/events are presented as live

required_surface: Division landing, property information, buy/sell, property management, education and enquiry
acceptance_test: Validate ownership, property data freshness, lead routing, brand separation and approved disclaimers
dependencies: ATR data sources; legal review; CRM/intake

required_surface: Only approved investment education/products and disclosures
acceptance_test: Review jurisdiction, licensing, claims, suitability, disclosures and payment/funds handling; no return guarantees or transaction activation by default

required_surface: Separate project integration contract only; no GEM-owned crypto routes assumed
route_or_evidence_candidates: External project route inventory not included in GEM count
acceptance_test: Owner supplies canonical repo, domain, API schema, auth scopes, data classification, rate limits and failure/incident contract

required_surface: Connect/disconnect providers, OAuth callbacks, credential health, scopes and emergency pause
acceptance_test: Readiness check and provider-authorized read-only probe; test state/PKCE/session binding and pause lock
dependencies: Provider OAuth apps; encrypted token store; workspace RBAC

required_surface: Approved content, queue, idempotency, retries, publish verification, pause and rollback
acceptance_test: Keep writes off until account auth, approval evidence, media readiness, idempotency and a human-approved test post are verified
dependencies: Provider approvals; queue/database; cron; media storage

required_surface: Provider metric sync, provenance, snapshots and analytics views
acceptance_test: Verify provider read scopes, metric mapping, freshness, dedupe, sync errors and dashboard values

required_surface: TikTok OAuth, app-review evidence, media publishing and shop/seller sync where approved
acceptance_test: Check app review, OAuth callback, scopes, media domain verification, encrypted tokens and explicit live-publish gate
dependencies: TikTok Developer; Shop/Seller API; encrypted secrets

required_surface: Product/service request, channel readiness, order intent and accurate non-transactional disclosure
acceptance_test: Confirm no unintended order/payment/subscription side effects; if activated, test idempotent checkout/webhooks/refunds/reconciliation

required_surface: Campaign draft/review, budget controls, external account binding and audit
acceptance_test: Confirm no provider API calls or spend occur; activation requires explicit account, budget, owner approval and pause path
dependencies: Ad provider OAuth; billing; campaign approval

required_surface: Subscribe/unsubscribe, consent, transactional email and deliverability
acceptance_test: Test opt-in, confirmation, unsubscribe suppression, bounce handling, SPF/DKIM/DMARC and transactional receipt

required_surface: Consent-gated inquiry handoff to separate command-center endpoint
route_or_evidence_candidates: enterpriseInquiryHandoff implementation; external origin documented in deep blueprint
acceptance_test: Use synthetic test only; verify HMAC, authorization, replay protection, receipt validation, contact permission, retention and timeout behavior
dependencies: External command-center service; shared contract/secret owner

required_surface: OpenAPI, scoped API credentials, status, agent endpoints and webhooks
acceptance_test: Validate canonical base URL, bearer-header redirect behavior, read/write scopes, schema, rate limits, replay protection and no secret exposure
dependencies: Agent client; API auth; external automation

required_surface: Upload, render job, worker dispatch, status, output and retention
acceptance_test: Test upload validation, job ownership, durable queue, retries, worker authentication, output scan and retention

required_surface: Health/readiness, smoke checks, monitoring, backups, recovery and rollback
acceptance_test: Run read-only health checks against canonical domain and record status/commit; rehearse restore/rollback in non-production

required_surface: Canonical domains, redirects, rewrites, sitemap and robots policy
acceptance_test: Compare every redirect/rewrite and sitemap path to actual HTTP status, canonical destination and indexability; ensure private/admin routes excluded

required_surface: Schema validation, migration history, RLS/tenant boundaries and safe rollback
acceptance_test: Compare migration history to non-production target, verify RLS/permissions/backups; never db push production

required_surface: Classify candidate repositories as canonical, integration, historical, duplicate, independent or unknown
route_or_evidence_candidates: Related repository register in deep blueprint; GitHub account repository list
acceptance_test: For each candidate record repository URL, purpose, last activity, deployment/domain, data/auth boundary, unique assets and owner approval

required_surface: Controlled desktop execution, inventory generation, tests, logs and rollback
acceptance_test: Run from clean checkout as standard user; verify repo/branch/SHA; dry-run first; capture exit codes and never expose secrets
dependencies: Windows PowerShell; Node; Git; package manager

required_surface: Privacy/terms/cookies/disclosures, jurisdiction, complaints, data rights and accurate public claims
acceptance_test: Legal owner reviews actual product data processing and claims; test consent/deletion/contact; do not claim certification without evidence
dependencies: Legal/compliance owner; consent and data inventory

required_surface: Responsive layout, keyboard navigation, labels, contrast, accessible errors and mobile menu
acceptance_test: Run automated accessibility scan and manual keyboard/iOS viewport checks on representative flows

required_surface: Structured logs, error tracking, alerting, incident runbooks and audit correlation
acceptance_test: Trigger controlled test error in preview, verify alert/log correlation, redaction and incident runbook ownership
dependencies: Vercel logs; monitoring provider; incident owner
